baselineContext: Project context: this repository uses Node.js 20, TypeScript ESM, explicit local provenance, append-only JSONL authority, deterministic offline relevance, review-required capture, and strict exclusion of raw prompts, source bodies, fetched text, secrets, credentials, instruction-shaped payloads, network services, daemons, watchers, vector databases, and embeddings.
